title: Leviticus Chapter 15 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Leviticus chapter 15 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Leviticus Chapter 15 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Leviticus Chapter 15.

questions.question: Who did the LORD speak to in Leviticus 15?
questions.correctAnswer: Moses and Aaron
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:1 states that the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 15, what makes a man unclean?
options: Having a running issue out of his flesh
questions.correctAnswer: Having a running issue out of his flesh
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:2 says any man with a running issue out of his flesh is unclean because of his issue.

questions.question: True or False: The flesh being stopped from the issue is considered uncleanness.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:3 states whether the flesh run with the issue or is stopped from the issue, it is uncleanness.

questions.question: What is said about the bed where a man with an issue lies?
questions.correctAnswer: It is unclean
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:4 declares every bed whereon he lieth that hath the issue is unclean.

questions.question: True or False: Anyone who touches the bed of a man with an issue must wash their clothes and bathe, and remains unclean until evening.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:5 instructs that whosoever toucheth his bed must wash clothes, bathe, and be unclean until the even.

questions.question: What must a person do if they sit on anything where a man with an issue has sat?
options: Wash clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until the even
questions.correctAnswer: Wash clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until the even
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:6 explains that the person must wash clothes, bathe, and be unclean until evening.

questions.question: True or False: Touching the flesh of a man with an issue does not require washing clothes or bathing.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:7 states that touching the flesh of him that hath the issue requires washing clothes, bathing, and uncleanness until evening.

questions.question: What happens if a man with an issue spits on a clean person?
options: The clean person must wash clothes, bathe, and be unclean until evening
The clean person must leave the camp
The clean person must offer a sacrifice
questions.correctAnswer: The clean person must wash clothes, bathe, and be unclean until evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:8 says if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean, then that person must wash clothes, bathe, and be unclean until the even.

questions.question: What is said about the saddle a man with an issue rides upon?
questions.correctAnswer: It is unclean
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:9 states that whatever saddle he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

questions.question: Who must wash their clothes and bathe if they carry anything that was under a man with an issue?
options: Only the man with the issue
questions.correctAnswer: Anyone who beareth those things
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:10 explains that he that beareth any of those things must wash clothes, bathe, and be unclean until the even.

questions.question: What must a person do if they touch a man with an issue and have not rinsed their hands in water?
options: Wash clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until the even
questions.correctAnswer: Wash clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until the even
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:11 mandates washing clothes, bathing, and uncleanness until evening for anyone touching a man with an issue without rinsing hands.

questions.question: What must be done to a vessel of earth that a man with an issue touches?
options: It shall be cleansed by fire
It shall be rinsed in water
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be broken
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:12 states that the vessel of earth touched by him with the issue shall be broken.

questions.question: In Leviticus 15, which instruction comes first?
options: Speak unto the children of Israel about uncleanness
Wash clothes after touching an unclean bed
Break vessels of earth touched by an unclean person
Offer a sin offering at the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: Speak unto the children of Israel about uncleanness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:2 is the first instruction where the LORD commands Moses to speak to Israel about uncleanness from a man with an issue.

questions.question: True or False: According to Leviticus 15, touching anything a woman with an issue sat upon makes a person unclean until the evening.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: This is not in the first third of the chapter; touching things a woman sat upon is addressed later, not in verses 1-11.

questions.question: What must a person do if they touch a man's bed or anything he sat on that has an issue?
options: Wash clothes, bathe in water, and remain unclean until the evening
questions.correctAnswer: Wash clothes, bathe in water, and remain unclean until the evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:5-6 states that those who touch a bed or sit on anything where a man with an issue has sat must wash clothes, bathe, and be unclean until evening.

medium.title: Leviticus Chapter 15 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Leviticus Chapter 15 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 15:12, what must be done to an earthen vessel that a man with an issue touches?
options: It must be rinsed with water
It must be purified with oil
questions.correctAnswer: It must be broken
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:12 states that the vessel of earth touched by a man with an issue shall be broken, while vessels of wood shall be rinsed in water.

questions.question: What must a man do after he is cleansed of his issue, according to Leviticus 15:13?
options: Number seven days for cleansing, wash clothes, and bathe in running water
Isolate himself for seven days without washing
questions.correctAnswer: Number seven days for cleansing, wash clothes, and bathe in running water
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:13 explains that after cleansing, a man must count seven days for his cleansing and wash his clothes and bathe in running water to be clean.

questions.question: What is the significance of the eighth day mentioned in Leviticus 15:14?
options: He must rest and do no work
He brings two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest
He is allowed to enter the tabernacle alone
questions.correctAnswer: He brings two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:14 directs that on the eighth day, the cleansed man brings two turtledoves or young pigeons to the priest at the tabernacle for offerings.

questions.question: What offerings does the priest make for the man with the issue as described in Leviticus 15:15?
options: One for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering
A thank offering and a sin offering
questions.correctAnswer: One for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:15 explains the priest offers one sacrifice for sin and another as a burnt offering to make atonement for the man’s issue.

questions.question: If a man's seed goes out from him, what does Leviticus 15:16 require him to do?
options: Wash all his flesh in water and be unclean until evening
questions.correctAnswer: Wash all his flesh in water and be unclean until evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:16 states that if a man’s seed goes out, he must wash all his flesh and be unclean until evening.

questions.question: What must be done to garments or skins with seed of copulation, according to Leviticus 15:17?
options: They must be washed with water and be unclean until evening
They must be rinsed with oil
questions.correctAnswer: They must be washed with water and be unclean until evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:17 requires that every garment or skin with seed of copulation be washed with water and remain unclean until evening.

questions.question: Based on Leviticus 15:18, what is required of both the man and woman after intercourse with seed of copulation?
options: They must both bathe in water and be unclean until evening
Only the man must wash his clothes
Only the woman must be put apart for seven days
They must offer a sin offering immediately
questions.correctAnswer: They must both bathe in water and be unclean until evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:18 commands that both the man and woman must bathe themselves in water and be unclean until the evening after intercourse with seed of copulation.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 15:19 say about a woman who has an issue of blood?
options: She shall be put apart seven days and anyone who touches her is unclean until evening
She must offer a burnt offering immediately
questions.correctAnswer: She shall be put apart seven days and anyone who touches her is unclean until evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:19 states the woman with an issue of blood is to be set apart for seven days, and anyone touching her becomes unclean until evening.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 15:20, what is the status of everything the woman with an issue lies or sits upon?
options: Only items touched directly are unclean
questions.correctAnswer: They are unclean
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:20 declares that everything she lies upon and sits upon during her separation becomes unclean.

questions.question: What must a person do if they touch the bed of a woman with an issue, as stated in Leviticus 15:21?
options: Wash clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening
questions.correctAnswer: Wash clothes, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:21 instructs that anyone touching her bed must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and remain unclean until evening.

questions.question: What is the consequence for touching anything she sat upon during her separation, according to Leviticus 15:22?
options: Wash clothes, bathe, and be unclean until evening
No consequence if hands are washed
questions.correctAnswer: Wash clothes, bathe, and be unclean until evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:22 states that touching anything she sat upon requires washing clothes, bathing, and being unclean until the evening.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 15:23 connect with verses 21 and 22 regarding uncleanness?
options: It confirms that touching her bed or sitting places causes uncleanness until evening
It states that touching her clothes causes no uncleanness
It explains a different ritual for cleansing
It says that only the woman is unclean, not others
questions.correctAnswer: It confirms that touching her bed or sitting places causes uncleanness until evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:23 reiterates that touching her bed or anything she sits on results in uncleanness until evening, connecting with verses 21 and 22.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 15:24 states that if a man lies with a woman during her issue, he becomes unclean for seven days and the bed becomes unclean.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:24 clearly states that if a man lies with her and her flowers (issue) are upon him, he shall be unclean seven days and the bed shall be unclean.

questions.question: True or False: According to Leviticus 15:25, a woman with prolonged issue beyond her separation days is considered clean.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:25 teaches that if a woman’s issue extends beyond her separation time, all the days of the issue are considered days of uncleanness.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 15:26-27 explain that anything the woman with an extended issue lies or sits upon is unclean, and those who touch these things become unclean until evening after washing and bathing.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:26-27 states that all beds and sitting places during the issue are unclean and touching them causes uncleanness until washing, bathing, and evening.

hard.title: Leviticus Chapter 15 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Leviticus Chapter 15.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 15:24, what is the period of uncleanness for a man who lies with a woman during her menstrual flow?
questions.correctAnswer: Seven days
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:24 states that the man shall be unclean for seven days if he lies with a woman during her menstrual flow.

questions.question: In Leviticus 15:28, after a woman is cleansed from her issue, how many days must she count to be considered clean?
questions.correctAnswer: Seven days
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:28 commands that after a woman is cleansed of her issue, she shall number to herself seven days before being clean.

questions.question: What offerings must a woman bring on the eighth day after her cleansing according to Leviticus 15:29?
options: Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
questions.correctAnswer: Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:29 specifies that on the eighth day, the woman shall bring two turtles or two young pigeons to the priest.

questions.question: Leviticus 15:31 emphasizes the purpose of these purity laws. What is the main reason for separating the children of Israel from their uncleanness?
options: So they die not in their uncleanness when they defile the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: So they die not in their uncleanness when they defile the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:31 clearly states that the separation is to prevent death due to uncleanness defiling God's tabernacle among them.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 15:23, what happens to a person who touches the bed or anything she sits on during her menstrual impurity?
options: They are unclean until the evening
They are only ceremonially unclean for one hour
questions.correctAnswer: They are unclean until the evening
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:23 states that touching her bed or any object she sits on causes uncleanness until the evening.

questions.question: What is the significance of the atonement offerings mentioned in Leviticus 15:30 in relation to the New Testament's understanding of cleansing?
options: They foreshadow Christ’s sacrifice for purification
They symbolize the Law of Moses only
questions.correctAnswer: They foreshadow Christ’s sacrifice for purification
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:30’s sin and burnt offerings typify the ultimate atonement by Christ, as seen in Hebrews 9:13-14 where Christ’s sacrifice cleanses from sin.

questions.question: Which verse in Leviticus 15 details the requirement to wash clothes and bathe oneself after touching objects associated with a man’s discharge?
questions.correctAnswer: Leviticus 15:10
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:10 instructs washing clothes and bathing after contact with things under a man with a discharge, showing the ritual cleanliness laws.

questions.question: True or False: According to Leviticus 15:27, anyone who touches the bed or objects a woman with an extended menstrual issue lies upon becomes unclean and must wash their clothes and bathe.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:27 clearly states that touching those things causes uncleanness requiring washing clothes and bathing until evening.

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word translated as 'issue' (used in Leviticus 15) primarily signify in the context of this chapter?
questions.correctAnswer: A bodily discharge
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word 'zav' (זָב) used in Leviticus 15 refers to a bodily discharge, signifying ritual impurity related to bodily fluids.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 15:26, what is the status of a bed where a woman with a menstrual issue lies during the entire period of her uncleanness?
options: It is considered unclean as the bed of her separation
It must be washed with oil
questions.correctAnswer: It is considered unclean as the bed of her separation
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:26 states that every bed she lies on during her issue is unclean like the bed during her separation.

questions.question: Which other Old Testament passage echoes the theme of ritual cleanliness and separation from uncleanness as in Leviticus 15?
questions.correctAnswer: Numbers 19:11-22
questions.explanation: Numbers 19:11-22 discusses the purification process after contact with the dead, paralleling Leviticus 15's themes of uncleanness and cleansing rituals.

questions.question: Leviticus 15:33 concludes the chapter by listing those affected by uncleanness. What literary device is used by grouping these various individuals and conditions together?
questions.correctAnswer: Inclusio
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:33 uses inclusio by framing the chapter’s subject matter, listing those unclean to emphasize the law’s scope and completeness.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 15 instructs that vessels of earth touched by one with a discharge must be rinsed in water to be purified.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:12 states that an earthen vessel touched by one with an issue must be broken, not rinsed; wooden vessels may be rinsed.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 15:25, how is the uncleanness period determined if a woman’s menstrual issue continues beyond the normal separation time?
options: It is extended to the additional days of the issue
She is always clean after seven days
It depends on the priest’s judgment
questions.correctAnswer: It is extended to the additional days of the issue
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:25 states that all days of the extended issue are counted as days of separation, extending the uncleanness period accordingly.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage reflects the theme of bodily purity and defilement found in Leviticus 15?
questions.explanation: Mark 7:14-23 discusses defilement coming from within the heart rather than external things, engaging with purity concepts introduced in Leviticus 15.

theological.title: Leviticus Chapter 15 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Leviticus Chapter 15 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What specific doctrine about ritual purity is taught in Leviticus 15:2 regarding a man with a running issue?
options: A man with a running issue is ceremonially unclean
A man with a running issue is physically sick but not unclean
A man with a running issue must be exiled
A man with a running issue is considered holy
questions.correctAnswer: A man with a running issue is ceremonially unclean
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:2 explicitly states that when a man has a running issue from his flesh, he is unclean because of his issue, teaching the doctrine of ritual impurity due to bodily discharges.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is reflected in the detailed cleansing procedures given in Leviticus 15:5 for one touching the bed of a man with an issue?
options: God's holiness requiring separation from impurity
God's mercy forgiving all sins without conditions
questions.correctAnswer: God's holiness requiring separation from impurity
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:5 requires washing clothes and bathing until evening for those touching the bed of the unclean man, reflecting God's attribute of holiness that demands separation from uncleanness (cf. Lev 11:44; 1 Peter 1:16).

questions.question: How does Leviticus 15:12 illustrate the seriousness of contamination through objects, and what does this reveal about God's nature?
options: The breaking of earthen vessels and washing of wooden vessels shows God's justice in maintaining purity
All vessels are destroyed to demonstrate God's wrath
Objects are never contaminated, showing God's leniency
Objects are blessed when they touch impurity, showing God's grace
questions.correctAnswer: The breaking of earthen vessels and washing of wooden vessels shows God's justice in maintaining purity
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:12 prescribes breaking earthen vessels touched by the issue and rinsing wooden ones, revealing God's justice in preserving holiness by preventing contamination (cf. Num 19:11-12).

questions.question: What combined theological teaching about purification and atonement emerges from Leviticus 15:13-15 regarding cleansing from an issue?
options: Cleansing requires a seven-day period, washing, and a priestly sin and burnt offering for atonement
Cleansing is immediate upon washing with no offerings needed
Only the sin offering is necessary for cleansing
Cleansing is symbolic and does not require the priest's involvement
questions.correctAnswer: Cleansing requires a seven-day period, washing, and a priestly sin and burnt offering for atonement
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:13-15 teaches that after cleansing from an issue, one must wait seven days, wash, and bring two birds for sin and burnt offerings, showing the doctrine of sanctification and atonement through priestly mediation (cf. Heb 9:13-14).

questions.question: In Leviticus 15:16-18, what doctrine about sexual purity and communal holiness is taught?
options: Both man and woman are unclean after sexual emission and must bathe
Only the man is considered unclean after sexual emission
Sexual emission does not affect ritual purity
Only garments are unclean, not the persons
questions.correctAnswer: Both man and woman are unclean after sexual emission and must bathe
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:16-18 states that both man and woman must bathe and be unclean until evening after sexual emission, teaching communal responsibility for holiness and sexual purity.

questions.question: What narrative arc does Leviticus 15:19-24 contribute to the broader redemptive story regarding women's purity laws?
options: It establishes ritual separation due to menstruation, foreshadowing Christ's perfect purification
It condemns women permanently for natural bodily functions
It abolishes all purity laws related to women
It makes no distinction between men and women in purity
questions.correctAnswer: It establishes ritual separation due to menstruation, foreshadowing Christ's perfect purification
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:19-24 sets laws for a woman's menstrual impurity and separation, which narratively points to the need for a perfect purification fulfilled in Christ, who cleanses from all defilement (cf. Heb 9:13-14).

questions.question: How does Leviticus 15:25-27 expand on the doctrine of uncleanness concerning prolonged bodily discharges?
options: Prolonged discharges extend the period of uncleanness and contamination of objects
Only initial discharges cause uncleanness, not prolonged ones
Prolonged discharges cleanse the person automatically
Objects remain clean regardless of prolonged discharges
questions.correctAnswer: Prolonged discharges extend the period of uncleanness and contamination of objects
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:25-27 teaches that if a woman's discharge continues beyond the normal period, she remains unclean and everything she touches is unclean, emphasizing the strictness of holiness laws.

questions.question: What synthesis of cleansing and priestly atonement is taught by combining Leviticus 15:28-30 about a woman being cleansed from her issue?
options: After seven days of cleansing, she offers two birds for sin and burnt offerings and the priest makes atonement
She is cleansed by washing alone without any offerings
The woman is permanently unclean and cannot be restored
Only a sin offering is required without a burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: After seven days of cleansing, she offers two birds for sin and burnt offerings and the priest makes atonement
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:28-30 teaches that after a seven-day cleansing period, the woman brings two birds for sin and burnt offerings, and the priest makes atonement, highlighting the combined need for purification and atonement.

questions.question: What theological significance does Leviticus 15:31 assign to the laws of uncleanness and atonement in relation to God's presence among Israel?
options: They separate Israel from uncleanness to prevent death and defilement of God's tabernacle
They are arbitrary laws without spiritual significance
They allow impurity to coexist with God's tabernacle
They only apply to outsiders, not Israel
questions.correctAnswer: They separate Israel from uncleanness to prevent death and defilement of God's tabernacle
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:31 states these laws serve to separate Israel from uncleanness lest they die and defile God's tabernacle, revealing God's holiness and justice in maintaining purity among His people (cf. Exodus 33:20).

questions.question: What doctrine about human sinfulness and the need for cleansing is conveyed by the laws concerning bodily discharges in Leviticus 15:32-33?
options: Both men and women with bodily discharges are defiled, showing universal human impurity
Only men are considered sinful due to bodily discharges
Bodily discharges are natural and carry no spiritual meaning
The unclean are excluded permanently from the community
questions.correctAnswer: Both men and women with bodily discharges are defiled, showing universal human impurity
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:32-33 declares that both sexes with discharges are defiled, teaching the doctrine of universal human impurity and the consequent need for cleansing and atonement.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that ancient purity laws are arbitrary and irrelevant. What does Leviticus 15:2-11 actually teach about the holiness of God and the nature of sin?
options: The laws emphasize God's holiness requiring separation from impurity and the serious nature of sin's defilement
The laws are mere cultural customs with no spiritual basis
The laws promote fear without purpose
The laws only concern physical cleanliness, not moral issues
questions.correctAnswer: The laws emphasize God's holiness requiring separation from impurity and the serious nature of sin's defilement
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:2-11 shows that impurity causes separation until cleansing, reflecting God's holy nature and the defiling power of sin, countering claims that purity laws are arbitrary (cf. Lev 11:44; Heb 12:14).

questions.question: What synthesis of ritual impurity and the necessity of priestly mediation do Leviticus 15:13-15 and 15:28-30 collectively teach?
options: Both men and women must undergo a period of cleansing and bring offerings for atonement through the priest
Only men require priestly mediation after cleansing
Priestly mediation is optional for cleansing
Cleansing and offerings are symbolic but not required
questions.correctAnswer: Both men and women must undergo a period of cleansing and bring offerings for atonement through the priest
questions.explanation: These passages show men and women must wait seven days, wash, and bring sin and burnt offerings for atonement by the priest, teaching the doctrine of sanctification requiring divine mediation.

questions.question: How do Leviticus 15:16-18 and 15:19-24 together reveal the theological principle of communal holiness regarding sexual relations and bodily discharges?
options: Both sexual emissions and menstrual discharges cause uncleanness affecting individuals and their environment
Sexual relations are not connected to holiness laws
Bodily discharges have no communal implications
questions.correctAnswer: Both sexual emissions and menstrual discharges cause uncleanness affecting individuals and their environment
questions.explanation: These verses teach that bodily discharges from sexual activity or menstruation cause uncleanness that affects persons and objects, emphasizing communal holiness and separation (cf. Lev 18:19).

questions.question: Which attribute of God is demonstrated by the command in Leviticus 15:31 to separate Israel from uncleanness to protect His tabernacle?
questions.correctAnswer: God's holiness and justice
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:31 commands separation from uncleanness to prevent defiling God's dwelling and death, highlighting God's holiness and justice in relation to His covenant presence.

questions.question: What doctrinal insight about the relationship between physical uncleanness and spiritual consequences is conveyed in Leviticus 15:4-6?
options: Physical uncleanness defiles objects and persons, requiring cleansing to restore fellowship
Physical uncleanness has no spiritual consequences
Only the individual is unclean, objects remain holy
Uncleanness is only symbolic and has no practical effect
questions.correctAnswer: Physical uncleanness defiles objects and persons, requiring cleansing to restore fellowship
questions.explanation: Verses 4-6 state that beds and objects associated with the unclean person are also unclean, and touching them requires washing and bathing, teaching that physical uncleanness has spiritual consequences affecting community and worship.
